title: Wayfare Pass Billing Standard — Unused-Period Share on a Move to Plus Monthly
content:
# Unused-period share on a move to Plus Monthly (Wayfare Pass)

**Standard.** When a Wayfare Pass (rider membership) membership moves up to Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly, the unused-period credit is the membership fees collected for the billing period in force less the fee refunds booked against them, multiplied by the unused-period share and rounded half up to the cent. The unused-period share depends on the timing and on the plan: where the latest membership fee charge is no more than the plan's full refund window in calendar days old on the change date and no Pass ride credit has been posted for the period, the share is the whole period; for an annual plan otherwise, the share is the whole calendar months of the period, counted from the period start's day of month, that begin after the change date, over twelve; otherwise the share is the days from the change date through the last day of the period, both days counted, over the days in the period, both end days counted.

## Figures by plan (the plan held before the move)

| Plan | Full refund window (calendar days) | Billing period | Share outside the first tier |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Pass Student | 2 | monthly | days remaining over days in the period |
| Wayfare Pass Monthly | 2 | monthly | days remaining over days in the period |
| Wayfare Pass Annual | 30 | annual | whole months beginning after the change date, over twelve |
| Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly | 2 | monthly | days remaining over days in the period |
| Wayfare Pass Plus Annual | 30 | annual | whole months beginning after the change date, over twelve |
| Wayfare Pass All Access Annual | 30 | annual | whole months beginning after the change date, over twelve |

## Reading the first tier

- **Age of the latest charge**: calendar days from the date of the latest membership fee charge on the membership ledger to the change date. On a 2-day window, a charge 2 days old qualifies and one 3 days old does not; on a 30-day window, 30 days qualifies and 31 does not.
- **Credit posted for the period**: any credit earn entry on the membership ledger for the billing period in force. One such entry is enough to leave the first tier.

| Latest charge within the window | Credit posted for the period | Share |
|---|---|---|
| yes | none | the whole period |
| yes | some | by months (annual plan) or by days (monthly plan) |
| no | either | by months (annual plan) or by days (monthly plan) |

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

1. Wayfare Pass Monthly, 9.99 collected on 19 June for the period 19 June to 18 July, move on 21 June, no credit posted: the charge is 2 days old, so the share is the whole period and the unused-period credit is 9.99.
2. The same membership with one credit earn entry for the period, move on 21 June: days 21 June to 18 July are 28 of 30, so the unused-period credit is 9.99 multiplied by 28 and divided by 30, that is 9.32.
3. Wayfare Pass Annual, 96.00 collected for a period beginning 10 January, move on 25 April: the charge is beyond 30 days; months beginning after 25 April are 10 May through 10 December, 8 of 12, so the unused-period credit is 64.00.
